text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Monday:
- Swiss President Jean-Pascal Delamuraz and King Norodom Sihanouk of Cambodia opened a children's hospital in Phnom Penh, the capital of Cambodia.
- Swiss journalist Oskar Reck died on Friday at the age of 76. He was editior-in-chief of several Swiss publications.
- Switzerland's largest information technology exhibition Orbit, which closed on Saturday, registered a new record with almost 100,000 visitors.
- Some 1,000 rerfugees from Bosnia-Herzegovina have left the country and Swiss authorities are offering to pay some 8,000 francs for each refugee who is willing to leave the country.
- Several towns in French-speaking areas in Switzerland registered a wave of juvenile crime.
- Swiss president Jean-Pacsal Delamuraz signed an investment protection agreement in Cambodia, his last stop on a 10-day tour of Asia.
